struct Dinic {
    int n, source, sink;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<int> level, ptr;
    queue<int> q;

    Dinic(int nodes, int s, int e) : n(nodes), source(s), sink(e) {
        graph.resize(n);
        level.resize(n);
        ptr.resize(n);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, ll cap) {
        graph[u].emplace_back(v, graph[v].size(), cap);
        graph[v].emplace_back(u, graph[u].size() - 1, 0);
    }

        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[source] = 0;
        q.push(source);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (auto& e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    ll dfs(int u, ll flow) {
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        for (int& i = ptr[u]; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge& e = graph[u][i];

                ll pushed = dfs(e.to, min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    graph[e.to][e.rev].flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll maxFlow() {
        ll total = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
            while (ll pushed = dfs(source, numeric_limits<ll>::max())) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
};

struct FlowEdge {
    int from, to;
    ll capacity, flow;
    FlowEdge(int f, int t, ll c) : from(f), to(t), capacity(c), flow(0) {}
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    int nodes, src, dst;
    vector<FlowEdge> edges;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    vector<int> level, current;
    queue<int> q;

    MaxFlowSolver(int n, int s, int d) : nodes(n), src(s), dst(d) {
        adj.resize(n);
        level.resize(n);
        current.resize(n);
    }

    void connect(int u, int v, ll cap) {
        edges.emplace_back(u, v, cap);
        edges.emplace_back(v, u, 0);
        adj[u].push_back(edges.size() - 2);
        adj[v].push_back(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    bool levelGraph() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[src] = 0;
        q.push(src);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                auto& e = edges[idx];
                if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[dst] != -1;
    }

    ll augment(int u, ll flow) {
        if (u == dst) return flow;
        for (int& i = current[u]; i < (int)adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            int idx = adj[u][i];
            auto& e = edges[idx];
            if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.capacity - e.flow > 0) {
                ll pushed = augment(e.to, min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edges[idx ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll solve() {
        ll result = 0;
        while (levelGraph()) {
            fill(current.begin(), current.end(), 0);
            while (ll pushed = augment(src, LLONG_MAX)) {
                result += pushed;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
};

struct Edge {
    int to;

    ll flow;
    int rev;
    Edge(int t, ll c, int r) : to(t), cap(c), flow(0), rev(r) {}
};

class FlowGraph {
public:
    int V, s, t;
    vector<vector<Edge>> adjList;
    vector<int> level;
    vector<int> nextEdge;

    FlowGraph(int nodes, int src, int dst) : V(nodes), s(src), t(dst) {
        adjList.resize(V);
        level.resize(V);
        nextEdge.resize(V);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, ll capacity) {
        adjList[u].emplace_back(v, capacity, adjList[v].size());
        adjList[v].emplace_back(u, 0, adjList[u].size() - 1);
    }

    bool buildLevelGraph() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (const auto& e : adjList[u]) {
                if (e.cap - e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    ll blockingFlow(int u, ll flow) {
        if (u == t) return flow;
        for (int& i = nextEdge[u]; i < (int)adjList[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge& e = adjList[u][i];
            if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.cap - e.flow > 0) {
                ll pushed = blockingFlow(e.to, min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;

                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    ll computeMaxFlow() {
        ll total = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph()) {
            fill(nextEdge.begin(), nextEdge.end(), 0);
            while (ll pushed = blockingFlow(s, LLONG_MAX)) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
};
